note: Known error signatures. tier: observed = seen in real logs or compiler output; lua = standard Lua runtime message; heuristic = a broad pattern that usually means this. Add new entries with the log line they came from.

signatures.meaning: redscript cannot find a name: a typo, a class/function removed by a game patch, a dependency mod that is not installed, or 'continue' on a 0.5.x compiler
signatures.fix: cpforge api search <name> to see what exists now; check the mod's requirements are installed; avoid 'continue' for 0.5.x

signatures.meaning: a function is not declared for redscript: renamed/removed by a patch, from a library mod that is not installed, or native-only (e.g. LogChannel without a logging-headers mod)
signatures.fix: cpforge api search <name>; use FTLog for plain logging, or declare the dependency in script_dependencies

signatures.meaning: redscript cannot resolve a type, function, member or module
signatures.fix: look the name up with cpforge api; a missing module usually means a required library mod is not installed

signatures.meaning: a field default is not a literal the compiler accepts (seen with a negative float default)
signatures.fix: use a plain literal default (0.0) and set the real value in OnAttach/constructor

signatures.meaning: the standalone compiler ran out of stack: a very large array literal, a very long '+' chain, or compiling a huge load order at once
signatures.fix: split big literals (e.g. one StrSplit over a delimited string), and compile your mod with only its dependencies (cpforge compile --deps)

signatures.meaning: two scripts define the same class, function or field; often an old copy of a mod left next to the new one, or two mods adding the same member
signatures.fix: delete the old mod folder before installing a new version; cpforge conflicts --what scripts

signatures.pattern: does not match|signature mismatch|wrong number of arguments
signatures.meaning: a hooked or called function's parameters changed in a game patch
signatures.fix: cpforge api class <Class> --filter <method> to see the current parameters

signatures.pattern: attempt to index a nil value
signatures.meaning: Lua read a field of something that does not exist (often a game object not ready yet, or an API renamed by a patch)
signatures.fix: guard with 'if x then', wait for onInit/session start, and check the name against the current game

signatures.pattern: attempt to call a nil value
signatures.meaning: Lua called a function that does not exist (renamed or removed by a game or CET update)
signatures.fix: check the function in the current CET/game version

signatures.meaning: a native plugin was built for another game version
signatures.fix: update that plugin (or RED4ext) to a build for your game patch

signatures.meaning: a resource path points at a file that is not in any loaded archive
signatures.fix: cpforge archive find <path> --vanilla to see which archive (if any) has it
